# Digizier

> Digital marketing and AI automation agency based in Karachi, Pakistan. Founded and led by Nadir Habib. Specializing in high-ROAS Meta and Google advertising funnels, 24/7 autonomous WhatsApp AI customer and sales bots, and n8n workflow integration pipelines.

## About Digizier
- **Founder & CEO:** Nadir Habib
- **Headquarters:** Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan (Serving clients across Pakistan, USA, UK, UAE, and globally)
- **Official Website:** https://www.digizier.com
- **Direct WhatsApp:** +92 322 2685688
- **Primary Contact Email:** info@digizier.com

## Core Agency Services
1. **Performance Digital Marketing:** Data-driven Meta (Facebook & Instagram) and Google ad campaigns with server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI) tracking for e-commerce and lead generation.
2. **AI Agents & WhatsApp Bots:** Bilingual (English & Urdu) autonomous AI sales assistants and customer support bots that qualify leads, handle inquiries, and confirm orders 24/7.
3. **n8n Workflow Automation:** Automated webhook pipelines integrating CRMs, payment gateways, Google Sheets, email alerts, and couriers without recurring third-party platform costs.
4. **High-Speed Web & E-Commerce Systems:** Next.js static web architectures delivering sub-second page loads with zero serverless hosting expense.
5. **Business Process Automation:** Structured operational audits and workflow engineering to eliminate repetitive manual bottlenecks.
